'''Isafdar''' ([[rsw:Transcript:Pronunciation_guide#I|Jagex pronunciation]]: ''ISS-aff-dar'') is the [[elven]] forest. It is the largest part of the region [[Tirannwn]], located on the very western edge of the mainland.

Isafdar is located just west of [[Lletya]], and south of [[Prifddinas]]. It is reachable by the [[Underground Pass (dungeon)|Underground Pass]] to the east, by [[Arandar]] to the north-east, as well as [[Port Tyras]] to the south-west of the forest.

==Features==
Isafdar is blanketed with traps, from [[tripwire|poison crossbows]] to [[Leaves (trap)|pitfalls with spikes]]. If you are travelling through Isafdar, make sure that you thoroughly check where you're walking or you risk dying. Worth mentioning are the [[Sticks (trap)|stick traps]]; you will always succeed those by spam clicking.

In addition to the traps, the forest is scattered with [[dire wolves]], and [[grizzly bear]]s. The dire wolves are usually found on the eastern and southern outskirts of the forest, and the bears usually travel in groups.

Towards the central forest, you can find [[White berries]], which are used for [[defence potion]]s and [[super defence potion]]s.

The fishing spots in the rivers of the forest contain [[Fishing#Fly fishing rods and feathers|fly fishing fish]]. At two spots at the south and south-east of the forest there are some [[yew tree]]s and at the south-east spot some [[magic tree]]s, and a mine with [[runite rocks|runite]] and [[adamantite rocks]]. At the northern edge of the river, along the ocean, there is also a fishing spot where players can [[Fishing#Nets|big net fishing]] and [[Fishing#Harpoon|harpoon]] for [[sharks]].

Towards the north-west of Isafdar is the [[Iorwerth Camp]], which has a handful of [[Iorwerth Archer]]s and [[Iorwerth Warrior|warriors]] and a [[spinning wheel]].

In the south-east of Isafdar is the secret entrance leading to [[Lletya]] and in the south-west corner is the [[Tyras Camp]].
